
Kiyesi 0.1.0 · break-in check · nothing leaves this server
web-1 · Ubuntu 25.04 (untested) · 11 signs checked in 1.0 s
Ubuntu 25.04 stopped getting security fixes on 15 Jan 2026
How to move to a release that still gets them: sudo kiyesi scan

1 sign of a break-in, and 2 things to look at

 SIGN  A crypto miner is running: xmrig (pid 4242)
       Miners earn attackers money.
       Fix: sudo kill 4242

 LOOK  root's shell history is sent to /dev/null
       Attackers turn history off.
       Fix: sudo rm ~root/.bash_history

 NOTE  root's login keys changed on 23 Oct 2026
       Each line in that file opens the server to whoever holds the key.
       Check the change was someone on your team.
       Fix: sudo kiyesi keys lists each key's fingerprint and comment. On
            your own computer, ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub prints
            yours to compare. Take out a key nobody recognises with sudo
            kiyesi keys remove <fingerprint>: it asks first, can be undone,
            and never takes your own last key

What to do now
 1. Do not wipe the server yet: take a snapshot at your provider, so there
    is evidence.
 2. From another computer, change every password and key this server held:
    database, cloud, payment, email.
 3. Build a fresh server from your code and backups, rather than cleaning
    this one.
 4. The full guide: https://docs.kiyesi.dev/guides/break-in/
